Commentary.Commentary: The pitch from hereon is only going to get tougher to bat. Bangladesh will have to plan their chase sensibly and avoid playing rash shots. The new ball has done the maximum damage so far as it has helped the spinners to grip well and get extra bounce. Let's see how the Bangla Tigers respond...

Bangladesh bowled well apart from that period when the 127-run partnership came between Stokes and Bairstow. After a below par effort in the first innings, Shakib bounced back with the ball and hunted down five wickets.

For England, once again it was their lower half which stepped up to save them the blushes. Ben Stokes was extraordinary in his effort with the bat and along with Jonny Bairstow stitched in a partnership which very well could be the match-winning one for them.

Okay then, only 12 runs added to the overnight total as Bangladesh managed to pick the remaining two wickets in quick time. But now the real work starts for them. They will have to bat out of their skins to scale down a target of 286 on this tricky surface.

OUT! Gone! Taijul dishes out an arm ball around off, Batty gets forward to defend, plays for the spin but to his disappointment it skids with the angle and raps him on the front pad. They appeal and the finger goes up without much delay. Batty takes the DRS but the replays confirm that it's hit him in line and is going on to disturb the leg stump. The decision stays as it is and ENGLAND ARE ALL OUT FOR 240!
Gareth Batty has been given out lbw! He has referred it. Looks dead to the naked eye.
A touch short and on off, Woakes gets back and punches it through covers for a single.
Second new ball is due now and Bangladesh have immediately opted for it. Reviews are reset. Taijul Islam has been inserted into the attack.
Edged but safe! Loopy ball on off, spinning away, Batty tries to drive it through covers but gets an outside edge past first slip for a couple of runs.
Once again Gareth gets forward confidently and defends it to the off side.
Floated full ball on middle, defended from the crease.
Slow loopy ball on off, Batty presses forward, allows the ball to come to him and then defends.
Again an arm ball on middle, Woakes hangs back and somehow turns it past short leg for a single.
Arm ball on off, skidding in, Woakes reads it off the pitch, goes back to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Goes back inside the crease and works it through square leg for a single.
Strides forward and pushes it with soft hands to covers.
Tossed up on middle, spinning in, Woakes fails to flick and it goes off his pads to Mominul at short leg.
Fullish and on off, Woakes gets forward and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Spin and bounce down the leg side, Batty lets it through and Rahim struggles to collect. A bye taken.
Flighted full ball on off, Batty gets forward in defense.
Gets back and eases it to mid-wicket for a single. He is off the mark and will be on strike for the next over. Not a smart move, Woakes should look to farm strike from here on.
Gareth Batty is the last batsman for England.

OUT! Well short! Needless from England! Flatter and quicker on middle, Woakes gets back to work it on the leg side but closes the face of the bat early. It goes off the leading edge to short third man and they attempt for a quick run. Broad responds but fails to make it as a flat throw comes to Rahim who does the rest. They appeal, the third umpire is referred and the replays show that Broad is not even in the frame. England lead by 278!
Appeal for a run out! Referred upstairs. Looks out to the naked eye.
A touch short and around middle, Woakes goes back and turns it through the gap at mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Arm ball on middle, Woakes goes back to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It dies in front of FSL.
Gets on the front foot and defends it watchfully with the spin to the off side.
Tossed up ball on off, gripping in and turning away, Woakes pushes it straight to point.
Shakib Al Hasan to bowl from the other end. He already has a fifer to his name.
Flighted and full on off, Broad lunges and blocks. No wicket in the first over of the day, unlike the last two days.
Too full on this occasion, Woakes nudges it down through mid on for a single.
Spinning into the batsman from around middle, Woakes clips it through mid-wicket and gets off the mark with a couple of runs.
Loopy full ball landing around middle, Woakes fails to flick and is hit on the back leg. Rahim appeals but it's missing leg and hence the umpire shakes his head.
Tossed up ball on middle, Woakes inside edges his attempted flick shot and it goes off his pads. Wide of Mominul at short leg.
Starts with a flighted full ball on off, Woakes drives it off his front foot to extra cover.

Right then, the players are on the field. Glorious day for the game of cricket. Clear blue skies and the sun is out in its full glory. Out come Chris Woakes and Stuart Broad, the two overnight batsmen for England. Mehedi Hasan to bowl first up...

Hello and welcome to day four of this intriguing Test match. England hold all the aces at the moment with a strong lead of 273. Just two wickets left though and they would look to surge past the 300-run mark. Bangladesh will want to restrict the opposition to as low a total as possible. Whatever the target, it will require a special effort from the hosts to win the match. The action isn't far away.
.....DAY 4, SESSION 1.....

With a lead of 273, England are sitting pretty on a pitch that is offering considerable turn and reverse swing with the older ball. They aren't done yet and will hope to set a target beyond 300. That might be a mountain to climb for Bangladesh, if it isn't already. Hope you loved our coverage of the day's play. Join us tomorrow at 0930 IST for the fourth day's play. Till then, take care and enjoy your weekend.

The other star all-rounder in the match, Shakib too made his presence felt by picking up his 15th fifer in Tests. He had led a brilliant Bangladeshi fightback to reduce England to 62/5 before Stokes and Bairstow intervened. The hosts would be a bit disappointed, first of all with their batting collapse and then with their inability to capitalize with the ball after having made early inroads.

255 runs and 13 wickets - a riveting day's play and it's England on top. Ben Stokes was the hero of the day with a brilliant all-round performance. He struck thrice this morning to finish with a 4-fer as Bangladesh collapsed to hand a 45-run lead to the tourists. He then contributed a valuable fifty too after coming into bat at 46/4. His 127-run stand with Bairstow rescued England from a very precarious position to well beyond safety.
Around leg and spinning down, Broad goes back to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. STUMPS ON DAY 3!
Floated and outside off, Broad gets forward and defends it to the off side.

NOT OUT! Tossed up ball landing outside leg, Broad gets forward to defend but misses and it pops out off his pads to short leg. Mominul collects the ball, they appeal but the umpire remains unmoved. Rahim has a chat with his fielder and then takes the DRS. The replays detect no inside edge. Bangladesh have exhausted all their reviews now.
Appeal for a bat-pad! Not given and Rahim takes the referral.
Loopy full ball on off, Stuart defends it off his front foot.
Quicker full ball landing outside leg, Broad pads it away.
Flatter and on the pads, Broad goes back and taps it gently to short leg.
Last over of the day to be bowled by Shakib Al Hasan. Can he add one more to his tally of five wickets?
Flighted and on middle, forced off the front foot to mid off.
Full and outside off, Woakes prods forward in defense.
Slower through the air, full and on middle, it's defended off the front foot.
Loopy and on middle, Woakes goes down and paddle scoops it down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Floated full ball on off, Woakes strides forward in defense.
Spin and bounce around off, Woakes pushes at it and gets beaten.
They are staying and it seems two overs remaining will be bowled. Around 5 minutes left in the extended half an hour.
A touch short and on middle, Woakes gets back and turns it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy and outside off, Woakes eases it off his front foot to covers.
Strides forward to a full ball and pushes it through extra cover for one.
FOUR! Flighted ball on middle, a shade quicker, Broad gloves his attempted sweep shot and it speeds fine down the leg side a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up ball on off, Broad tries to sweep but misses.
3 overs left in the day's play. But the natural light has faded considerably and artificial lights are switched on. This might be the last over before stumps.
Goes down on one knee and paddles it towards short fine leg for one.
Tossed up ball outside off, Broad gets forward and across to defend it near his front pad.
Gets forward to a full ball and jams it down safely.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Works it with the spin but finds short mid-wicket.
Flighted full around off, Broad lunges and defends it off the inner half of the bat. Straight to silly point.
Taijul Islam is back on.
Loopy on a length on leg, pushed off the back foot.
Fired in on middle, Woakes leans across and clips it to mid-wicket.
Spears it fuller on middle, dug out towards mid on.
Fuller outside off, Woakes gets the stride in and smothers it.
Loopy off break spinning in sharply, Woakes gets a faint inside edge past short leg.
Tossed up outside off, very full and Woakes keeps it out with a straight bat.
Mehedi Hasan is back on.
Floated on off, Broad connects the sweep again but the ball crashes into the fielder at forward short leg.
Flatter on leg stump, stays back and taps it towards short leg.
Very full on middle, Broad digs it out down the track.
FOUR! Good stroke! Fuller outside off, Broad fetches it with a powerful sweep to the deep square leg fence for a boundary. Struck it really hard.
Fuller on middle, Broad lunges into it and just about manages to block it.
Fuller outside off, Woakes pushes at it as the ball goes off the outer half towards short third man. Single taken.
Shortish around off, blocked well off the back foot.
Good length angled in outside off, Broad is happy letting it pass.
Length ball angled away outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Length ball outside off, steered down to third man for a single.
Full and outside off, Woakes leans forward and pushed to point.
Good length on off, Woakes hangs back and blocks it out just in time.
Speared in around leg stump, Broad gets across and clips it to leg gully.
Flatter outside leg, Broad misses the flick and is struck on the pads.
Stuart Broad walks out to bat.

OUT! It is indeed pad first! 15th Test fifer for Shakib! This was darted in on off, Rashid looks to block with his bat just behind the front pad. He manages to get some bat on it but it appears to have brushed his pad first. Appeal for lbw but not given. Rahim decides to review it. Replays show that it is pad first. Over to Hawk Eye. Impact in line and that's crashing into middle stump. Great performance from Shakib, he's bowled tirelessly today. Lead is 258 now.
Bangladesh have taken a review for lbw against Rashid. Was it pad first?
Drifting in on a length on off, blocked well off the back foot towards point.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
Fuller on middle, Rashid pushes at it as the ball rolls to the right of short leg.
Good length on off, Woakes defends it well from the crease.
Short on off, pulled away to the leg side for a single.
Good length outside off, blocked off the front foot.
Very full and around off, Rashid digs it out to the off side.
Fuller on middle, Woakes gets across and clips it to the leg side.
Very full on off, Woakes just about manages to dig it out. Goes off the outside edge to third man for a single.
Flatter on off, Rashid hangs back and pushes it to short cover.
Fuller around leg stump, Rashid gets across to block but is pinned on the front pad.
FOUR! Pulled away! England are doing well by maximizing the bad balls. This is a long hop from Shakib and Rashid climbs on to it with a pull through mid-wicket. That raced to the fence.
Drifting in on off, Rashid pushes at it with the bat before his front pad.
Floater outside off, pushed off the front foot to the covers.
Two Leg byes! Flatter ball around leg stump, Rashid misses the flick and the ball rolls off the pads down the leg side past the keeper. A couple of leg byes added.

FOUR! How did that miss the stumps? Fuller and around off, tails in sharply at the last moment. Woakes pushes at it and gets an inside edge that almost shaves leg stump on its way to the fine leg fence. LEAD IS NOW 250.
Slower bouncer but down the leg side. Woakes fails to connect the pull.
Length ball outside off, Woakes lunges into it and defends it well.
Good length on off, blocked well off the back foot on to the track.
Fuller on off, Woakes drives it to mid on with the inside half of the bat.
Fuller and around off, blocked well off the front foot to short cover.
FOUR! Crunched! Valuable runs these! A touch short outside off and Rashid rocks back nicely to play a fine back foot punch through the covers. Finds the fence with finesse.
Slider on middle, Rashid blocks it well off the back foot.
Too full and outside off, driven firmly towards mid off.
Drifting in from off, Rashid blocks it by getting behind the line.
Adil Rashid is the new man in.

OUT! Shakib has his fourth! Fuller on off, it's too full for the sweep but Stokes goes through the stroke. Misses it and is rapped on the front pad. Loud appeal for lbw and it's upheld. Stokes thinks for a while and then decides to review but he's run out of time. He has to go but not before playing an excellent knock. Bangladesh now chipping away at the wickets. Lead is 242 though. England will want to get it past 275 at least.
Floated on middle, Stokes gets back and nudges it to short leg.
Angles in a full ball on middle, Woakes brings down a straight bat in defense.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Length ball angling away outside off, some extra bounce as well, Stokes feels for it and gets beaten.
Fuller outside off, Stokes shuffles across and wrists it but straight to mid on.
Fuller outside off, Stokes reaches out and drives it to cover.
Almost a chance! Fuller on middle, Woakes checks his flick stroke and lobs it just past the two short mid-wicket fielders lurking nearby. Single taken.
Beaten! Drifting in from outside off, turn and bounce to beat the outside edge.

SIX! Blasted away! Drops it short on middle, Stokes is quick to feast on the long hop and deposits it over deep square leg with a meaty pull. He hasn't missed out any scoring opportunities and that's been a hallmark of his innings today.
And again! Almost a replica of the previous ball. Drifting in on middle, turns in with low bounce. Stokes just manages to chop it to the leg side.
Flatter on middle, keeps a bit low as Stokes goes back to chop it to the leg side.
Fuller around leg stump, Stokes misses the sweep as the ball goes off the pads to leg gully. Stifled lbw appeal but probably missing leg.
Flatter outside leg, Stokes goes back to flick but is hit on the pads as the ball goes to leg gully.
Good length outside off, chopped towards point.
Fuller and tailing in from middle stump, Woakes adjusts late to tuck it to short mid-wicket.
Chris Woakes is the new man in.

OUT! Chopped on! Bangladesh finally break the partnership. Length ball on off, not much width but Bairstow goes through with the cut stroke. Gets an inside edge that crashes into the stumps. Rabbi is pumped up, it's his maiden Test wicket. What a time to take it! Bangladesh desperately needed it. Ends a brilliant 127-run stand. Bairstow departs after a fine knock. Lead is now 234.
Full and wide outside off, Stokes has a go at it and gets a thickish edge that flies down to third man on the bounce. Single taken.
Dug in short on off, muscles the pull towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Great stroke! Fuller and on the pads, easy pickings for Bairstow who flicks it really well. Splits fine leg and deep square leg to perfection to find the fence.
Fuller on middle, Bairstow works it towards mid-wicket for a single to keep strike.
Tossed up on off, JB reaches out and taps it to point.
Fuller on middle, defended well off the front foot.
Floated well outside leg, Bairstow just pads it away.

FOUR! Beautiful shot! A bit short and on leg stump, Jonny stays back to that one and punches it through mid-wicket. Timing was so good that it raced away to the fence in a jiffy. The lead continues to swell for England.
Drifting in outside leg, Stokes steps out and tries the slog sweep. Rebounds off the short leg fielder and goes towards the short fine leg region. Single taken.
Fuller on leg stump, Bairstow shuffles across to flick but is pinged on the pads. Stifled lbw appeal. That was clearly missing leg.
Fuller and outside off, JB presses forward and blocks it with the full face of the bat.
Short of a length outside off, flat-batted to mid off for a single.
Four Leg byes! Free runs! Full and well down the leg side, Stokes misses the flick but the ball flies off the pads down to the fine leg fence. Runs coming thick and fast for England. Lead is now 221.
Good length around off, slanting in, Stokes stands tall and punches it towards mid on.
Length ball angled in from well outside off, no shot offered.
Good running! Fuller outside off, Stokes stays deep in the crease and jams it to the off side. Soft hands and they scamper through for a single.
Shorter and outside off, punched off the back foot through cover for a single.
Drifting in around leg stump, JB looks to sweep but is hit on the body.
Tossed up around leg stump, Stokes sweeps and gets a faint top edge over backward square leg. Lands well safe in the deep as the batsmen get a single.
On a length on leg stump, worked off the back foot through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on off, Bairstow presses forward and pushes at it with soft hands to the off side.
Drinks break.
Drops it on a length and outside off, Stokes plays it out from the crease to point. Good over but not an effective one. England continue to march!
Full around middle, moving in a bit late, Bairstow nudges it through mid-wicket and crosses.
An overpitched delivery outside off, driven firmly square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Bowls it with a slinging action and darts in a length ball on off, Stokes keeps himself on the back foot and defends it to the off side.
Bowls it on a length and wide outside off, an easy leave for Stokes.
Angles in a full ball on off, Ben defends it by getting forward.
Kamrul Islam Rabbi is back into the attack.
A low dipping full toss on off, Bairstow pushes it with soft hands to short extra cover.
Flighted and full around leg, Stokes goes down one one knee and sweeps it through square leg for one.
Flatter and on the pads, nudged through the leg side for a single as the square leg fielder comes in from the deep to stop the ball.
Loopy full ball on off, Bairstow prods forward in defense.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single
Tossed up ball on middle, helped off the pads to the fielder standing on the right side of the square leg umpire.
100-run stand between Bairstow and Stokes.
Slips a full ball down the leg side, Jonny fails to flick and the keeper also fails to stop it. Bonus runs for England as a couple of byes have been added to the total.
Full length ball on middle and leg, Stokes bunts it off his pads towards mid on and runs across for a brisk single. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end. He anyway was in!
Stokes has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Shafiul is on the shorter side with his gentle pace, it's around off and Stokes shows no mercy. He rides the bounce and hammer-pulls it to the cow corner boundary.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. No run.

Ouch, that would have hurt! An attempted bouncer around middle, not rising much, Stokes is early into the pull shot and hence misses. He takes a blow on his left hip and goes down in pain. Nothing serious though, as he gets up after taking a few deep breaths.
Gets forward and pushes it with soft hands to covers. Looks for a run but is sent back.
Loopy ball pitching outside leg, Jonny once again pads it away.
Full in length outside off, spinning in a bit, Stokes gets back and punches it to the right side of the mid off fielder for a single.
ENGLAND LEAD BY 200 RUNS! Spinning away from the right-hander, Bairstow gets back and punches it through covers for a single.
Tossed up landing outside leg, Jonny pads it away!
Full flighted ball on off, Bairstow gets forward in defense.
Tucks a full length ball to deep square leg and crosses for a single.
False shot, play and a miss outside off. A lapse in concentration on Bairstow's part.
Spears in a yorker on middle, Jonny does well to dig it out.
Fuller in length and outside off, holding its line, Bairstow shoulders arms.
Pitches it full and outside off, from over the wicket, Jonny pushes it off his front foot to short cover.
Full and angling into the batsman, from around the wicket, Stokes flicks it in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Lunges and defends it with the spin to the off side.
FOUR! Shakib drags his length short outside off, Bairstow rocks back with the square cut and it speeds off from the outer half of the bat. Beats backward point to the fence.
Action replay of the previous delivery.
Spin and bounce around off, Bairstow plays inside the line, not entirely as he withdraws his bat.
Flatter and shorter landing outside off, it spins back in, Stokes goes deep inside the crease and punches it down to long on for a single.
Flighted full ball on off, Stokes presses forward in defense.
After just one over from Mahmudullah, Mushfiqur Rahim brings his ace bowler, Shakib Al Hasan into the attack. He clearly wants wickets. The current partnership is hurting them.
Full length ball angling into the batsman, Jonny sticks on his back foot and presents a straight bat in defense.

Lucky runs! On a length and outside off, Bairstow once again flirts with a wide delivery and gets an inside edge this time. It misses the stumps by a few inches and runs down to fine leg. A couple of runs taken.
Pitches it full and outside off, Bairstow plays a drive away from his body, middles it well but fails to beat the short cover fielder.
Finally gets bat on ball and connects his flick shot. A single taken as the ball moves to deep mid-wicket.

Full length ball on middle and leg, angling down, Stokes once again fails to flick and is hit on the pads. The bowler appeals but the umpire shows no interest. Jonny comes running down the track to steal a leg bye but is sent back.
Wrong start, runs in from around the wicket and slips a length ball down the leg side, Stokes fails to flick it off his pads.

Shafiul Islam is introduced into the attack from the Rocket End. Let's see if gets the ball to reverse. Only a silly mid off fielder in place in the name of a close-in fielder. Bangladesh looking on defensive. England lead by 189!
A rank long hop on off, Stokes stands back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Drifting into the batsman around off and spinning away, Stokes goes back, watches the line and reads the spin and then leaves it alone.
Flighted and on off, Stokes presses forward and defends.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Mahmudullah bowls a freebie, short and wide outside off, begging to be hit, Stokes latches onto it and whacks it to the sweeper cover fence.
Short and on middle, Bairstow goes deep inside the crease and pulls it in front of square for a single.
Flatter and around off, punched off the back foot to short mid-wicket.
Mahmudullah comes into the attack.
Fetches a full ball from outside leg and reverse sweeps it through point for a single.
Loopy full ball on off, Stokes gets forward and pushes it through covers for one.
Short and on off, spinning away, Stokes gets back and punches it through extra cover for a couple of runs.
Knocks a full ball down through mid on for a single.
Fullish around leg, spinning down, left alone.
Plays it with the spin on the leg side, finds FSL.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Tossed up ball outside off, left alone.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Stokes has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flighted ball on off, Stokes defends it off his back foot.
7th Test fifty for Ben Stokes!
SIX! Stokes is making his intentions clear. Receives a short ball in his half, goes back and launches it over mid-wicket for a biggie. Reaches his fifty in style.
Mehedi switches to over the wicket and bowls a full ball on off, Stokes pushes it out off the outside edge to third man and collects a single. He is playing a potential match winning knock!
Loopy and on off, Stokes draws forward in defense.
FOUR! Dismissed! Hasan drags his length short outside off and Stokes picks it in a trice. Immediately goes on the back foot and pulls it disdainfully to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Tossed up ball on middle, spinning away a touch, Ben gets back and defends it down calmly.
Full flighted on off, defended off the front foot.
Short and around off, Stokes goes back and plays a full-blooded cut shot. Kayes at short cover makes an outstanding diving stop.
Full flighted on off, Stokes lunges, brings his wrists into play and forces it down through mid on for a run.
FOUR! Goes down on one knee and sweeps it across the line. Fails to middle it and it goes off the top half of the bat through the vacant leg slip region for a boundary. Stokes moves to 40!
Sharp spin from the rough outside off, Ben defends it from the crease.
Flatter and outside off, Stokes blocks it off his back foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Quicker through the air, landing around off and spinning down, Stokes offers no shot and it goes off his pads to short leg.
Tossed up ball on middle, Bairstow goes back to work it on the leg side but there is a little extra bounce and he misses. Gets hit high on the pads.
Flighted on middle, spinning down, Jonny leaves it alone.
Tries playing the reverse sweep but fails to connect properly.
Throws it up short and wide outside off, Stokes mistimes his punch shot towards mid off. The ball rolls slowly towards mid off and they steal a single.
Pushes it from wide of the crease and with a round-arm action, it skids on after landing around off and Stokes brings his bat down just in time in defense.
Loopy off spinner on off, Stokes gets back and defends it with the spin to the off side.
Quicker one on the leg stump line, Bairstow fails to connect with his attempted sweep shot.
Tossed up ball on off, defended by Jonny.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Stays back and pushes it to point.
Full around middle, spinning down, Stokes hits it across the line and the mid-wicket fielder runs across to his left before diving to stop the ball. Cannot prevent the single though.
Flatter on middle, punched off the back foot to short mid-wicket.
50-run stand between Bairstow and Stokes!

FOUR! Thumped! Flighted ball on middle, too full in length, Bairstow gets down on one knee and sweeps it sweetly through square leg for a boundary. The horizontal bat shots are not easy to execute on this surface but he pulls it out quite well. A vital stand this for the English team.
Tossed up ball on off, Stokes kneels and sweeps it past backward short leg for a single.
Full floated on off, Stokes presses forward and jams it down.
Ben has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Spinning away from the batsman after landing around off, Stokes goes back to defend but is beaten by the away turn.
Flighted full ball on off, Stokes gets forward in defense.

Welcome back for the final session. The men concerned are back on the field. 33 overs left in the day's play. Bangladesh find themselves a bit on the back foot and will need to pick quick wickets to stay in hunt. England are not out of the jail but will hope that their lower order stands up and take the lead well past 200. Let's see what happens. Mehedi Hasan to bowl...
.....DAY 3, SESSION 3.....

Shakib bowled tirelessly from one end and was easily the pick of the bowlers. Mehedi did get the ball to grip but wasn't as threatening as he was in the first innings. Fatigue may be a reason for that as the 18-year old has already bowled more than 50 overs in the game. Anything over 200 would be a huge task to chase down on this track. Even the current lead of 153 is decent. Which team will end the day on top? Join us in a while for the final session of the day to find out.

A very even session due to the Stokes-Bairstow partnership. The first hour went to Bangladesh as they picked up the wickets of Ballance and Ali. However, since then Stokes and Bairstow have added 46 vital runs for the sixth wicket without being separated. The lead has stretched past the 150-run mark and Bangladesh are slowly starting to feel the heat.
Very full on middle, squeezed out towards short cover by Bairstow. THAT SHALL BE TEA ON DAY 3.
Quicker ball outside off, punched off the back foot to short cover.
Spinning away after drifting in, forces the outside edge but JB played it with soft hands and so it doesn't carry to slip.
Great ball! Drifting in from outside off, Bairstow pushes at it and is beaten all ends up being beaten due to the away spin.

FOUR! Good shot! A bit short and outside off, spinning away, Bairstow pounces on it with a back foot punch through the covers. Fielder in the deep did well to get to the ball with a slide but ends up parrying it past the ropes.
Tossed up outside off, presses forward and blocks it to short cover.
Final over before tea coming up.
Back of a length outside off, blocked off the back foot to point.
Short and outside off, Stokes slams it hard to short extra cover where the fielder gets a hand on it to make a fine half-stop.
Good length around off, Bairstow gets an inside edge on to the pads as the ball rolls away to the leg side. Single taken.
Shortish outside off, glided down to third man for a single.
Back of a length outside off, no stroke offered to that one.

FOUR! Hammered! Seeing a pacer made Stokes smile and the offering first ball made him happier. Short, outside off and the southpaw slams it through extra cover for a boundary. Stand and deliver stuff! That was dismissed with disdain.
First signs of pace in the innings as Kamrul Islam Rabbi comes on to bowl.
Tossed up on middle, JB reaches out and dead bats it to the track.
Very full around leg stump, JB misses the sweep to be rapped on the front pad. Muted lbw appeal but that was missing leg.
Flatter outside off, punched well off the back foot.
Very full on middle, JB makes room and squeezes it to short cover.
Sliding in on middle, Stokes goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller on off, Stokes pushes it back to the bowler.
Very full and closer to off, JB plays across to it and smothers the ball.
Full toss and Bairstow bunts it straight to mid on. Slight fumble but no run taken.
Slider outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Short and spinning away, Bairstow goes back and cuts but straight to cover.
Quicker ball on middle, worked to the leg side.
Full and outside off, slower through the air and JB pushes it to cover.
Tossed up fuller outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Drifting in around leg stump, another good sweep by Stokes to deep backward square leg. Single this time.
A bit short and spinning into the pads, Stokes gets back and whips it to square leg.
Quicker ball on middle, Stokes defends it well from the crease.
Loopy on leg stump, turns in as Stokes looks to flick. Bobbles straight to short leg but only pad.
Quicker ball on leg stump, Stokes gets back and nudges it down to fine leg for a brace.

FOUR! Good stroke! Flatter on middle, Bairstow goes down on one knee and sweeps it very hard through backward square leg for a boundary. It's a tough shot to play with variable bounce but he did well.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Fired in around leg stump, Jonny lets it pass down the leg side.
Quicker ball on off, Bairstow presses forward and defends well.
Fuller outside off, pushed off the front foot to cover.
Loopy and spinning away from well outside off, no shot offered.
Sliding on middle and leg, worked off the back foot towards FSL.
Flatter outside off, blocked off the back foot to the covers.
Narrow escape for Stokes! A few dots and he decides to play the reverse sweep again. Misses it and is struck on the front pad. The impact saves him as the lbw appeal is turned down.
Quicker ball on leg stump, Stokes looks to flick as the ball lobs in the air past leg gully. Went off the pads.
Drifting in from around leg, Stokes goes for the sweep but is struck on the pads.
Floats it up around off, Stokes presses forward and blocks it solidly.
Darted in with a round-arm action on off, Jonny goes back and pushes it to short cover.
Flatter on a length on off, Bairstow goes right back and blocks it out.
Drifting in from around off, Stokes goes back and whips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller on leg, Stokes clears his front leg and jams it to short mid-wicket.
Short and spinning away, nicely cut by Bairstow but it is well stopped at deep cover. Single taken.
Fuller on middle and leg, Bairstow reaches out to that one and clips it just past short leg.
Loopy on middle, Stokes clips it towards mid-wicket.
Floated on middle, spinning in a touch as Stokes goes back to clip it to forward short leg.
Flatter ball around off, a touch short as Stokes camps back to punch it to mid off.
Floated around off, Stokes presses forward and defends it on to the track.
Flatter ball outside off, premeditated sweep from Bairstow and he gets it behind square leg for a single.
Lovely ball! Drifting in from outside off, turning away to beat the outside edge.
Quicker ball on a length on off, Stokes camps back this time and defends firmly.
Flatter on middle, Stokes leans forward and blocks it solidly.
Changes to around the wicket.
Loopy and spinning down the leg side, no stroke offered by Stokes.
Flatter outside off, Stokes punches it off the back foot to wide mid off.
Quicker ball outside off, Stokes stays in the crease and blocks.
Quicker on middle, worked off the back foot towards mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker ball on leg stump, worked off the back foot to the leg side.
Fuller on leg stump, goes for the sweep but is struck on the pads.

SIX! THAT'S SMASHED! Floated on middle, Stokes goes for the slog sweep with the turn. Goes a bit off the top edge but still manages to clear deep square leg with ease. Positive blow from the all-rounder. He'll surely fight fire with fire.
Switches to around the wicket.
Fuller and spinning down the leg side. Left alone.
Loopy on leg stump, spins in as Stokes looks to flick. Lobs off the pads and falls before the short leg fielder.
Spinning down the leg side, Stokes fails to connect the flick.
Taijul Islam is back on.
Flatter down the leg side, Bairstow looks to sweep but misses.
Drifting in from outside off, pushed off the back foot to cover. Single taken.

Five Byes! Bonus runs! Drifting in from outside off, shoots through low to beat the edge. Rahim fails to gather it and the ball rebounds off the helmet lying behind the fielders. Five penalty runs to the total.
A bit short on leg stump, keeps low but Stokes adjusts well to pull. Straight to the man at square leg.
A bit short outside off, punched off the back foot to deep cover for a single.
Quicker ball outside off, skids on after pitching as Jonny lets it pass.
Shin pads coming in for Mominul. Meanwhile, the England players take a drink as there is a slight hold up in play.
Loopy around off, Stokes stays back to that one and defends it firmly.

FOUR! Risky stroke but Stokes pulls it off. Floated on off, Stokes employs the reverse sweep and connects it well to send it to the deep backward point fence. High risk shot on such a surface but it's a high reward one too if you get it right.
Drifting in on a length from outside off, blocked off the back foot to short cover.
Fuller on off, Stokes reaches out and jabs it towards forward short leg.
Floated on middle, Bairstow steps out to convert it into a full toss. Pushed to mid on for a brisk single.
Low full toss on the pads, Stokes makes room and digs it through wide mid on for a single.
Drifting in from around off, Bairstow gets right behind the line and defends.
Flatter and a bit short outside off, punched off the back foot to short cover.
Flatter on middle and off, Stokes stays back and wrists it through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy on middle and off, Stokes skips down the pitch and defends it.
Floated on a length outside off, nicely blocked off the back foot to short cover.
Leg bye! Slider on leg stump, Bairstow misses the sweep and the ball rolls off the pads to short fine leg. The batsmen take a leg bye.
Sliding in from outside off, Stokes stays back and blocks with the full face of the bat.
Quicker ball outside off, defended well from the crease.
Flighted closer to off, Stokes gets the stride in and defends it out.

Floated up on off, Bairstow pushes at it but the ball goes off the inside half through mid-wicket. Single taken. BAIRSTOW NOW HAS THE MOST RUNS BY A WICKETKEEPER BATSMAN IN A CALENDAR YEAR. What an achievement! He goes past the great Andy Flower.
Fuller outside off, reaches out and defends it well.
Fuller on middle, Bairstow leans forward and taps it to short mid-wicket.
Floating in around leg stump, Stokes stays back and jams it to FSL.
Drifting in from outside off, a bit short and Stokes blocks it off the back foot.
Flighted on off, pushed off the front foot towards short mid-wicket.
Flatter on middle and leg, swept away towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Gets a ripper first ball! Drifting in from outside off, Bairstow is squared up totally as the ball spins away square with bounce.
Jonny Bairstow is the new man in. He's greeted by a slip, a gully, a silly mid off and a forward short leg.
Drinks break.

OUT! Moeen Ali departs! Big blow to the English team! A flighted ball landing around off and spinning in, Moeen gets forward and across to play the sweep shot but fails to middle it. It hits him on the pads, pops out and takes the back of the bat. The bowler turns back to appeal for an lbw and in the meanwhile Rahim swiftly moves forward and dives to take the catch. The appeal now gets stronger and Moeen walks even before the finger goes up. Third wicket for Shakib, he has bowled a lot better in this innings. England lead by 107 runs!
Flatter one on off, defended from the crease by Stokes.
Wrong length outside off, Moeen gets back and cracks it to deep cover for a single.
A touch shorter on off, Stokes goes back and punches it through cover-point for a single.
Full and around off, drifting in and spinning away, Stokes goes back and blocks it.
Flatter on off, defended off the back foot.
Straightaway beats the batsman! Floated full ball outside off, Stokes strides forward to defend but it spins away to beat the outside edge.
Mehedi Hasan is back for another spell.
Fuller delivery on the pads, it's helped with gentle hands to short leg.
Flighted and on off, Moeen lunges in defense.
Flattish and shortish outside off, Moeen defends it off his back foot.
Loopy full ball on off, Stokes gets forward and eases it through mid on for a single.
Fuller and on off, Stokes stays back in defense.
Nearly drags it on! Spinning back into the batsman from outside off, Stokes tries to punch it through the line but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
This one is too full and around middle, Stokes forces it down to long on and takes a single.
Turning down the leg side, Stokes nudges it on the leg side but finds the fielder.
Quicker one on off, Stokes gets behind the line and blocks.
Another one down the leg side, Stokes this time tries to flick but misses.
Down the leg side, an easy leave.

Tossed up ball on off, Moeen sweeps it firmly across the line and places it right through the gap between the square leg fielder and umpire for a single. The umpire did well to move away from the way.
Flatter on off, Stokes is on the back foot in defense.
Flighted on middle, Stokes draws forward and defends it off the inside edge.
Loopy ball on leg, Moeen kneels and sweeps it to long leg for a run.
Drags his length short and lands it outside off, Stokes goes back and pulls it to wide long on for a single.
Pushes it flatter and quicker on middle, Ben uses the depth of the crease and defends.
Stokes has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Loopy ball on off, Moeen plays the reverse sweep, middles it well but finds the backward point fielder.
A touch short on this occasion, Stokes goes back and punches it against the spin through extra cover. The fielder chases it down in the deep and they take three runs.
Quicker ball on off, turning in, Stokes defends it at the last moment from the crease.
Spinning back in from outside off, Moeen walks down the track to defend but misses. It goes off his pads to short cover and they pinch a leg bye.
Slow spin back into the left-hander from outside off, Moeen goes on the back foot and defends it to short leg.
Full and spinning back into the batsman, Stokes goes back and works it to deep mid-wicket for an easy run.
Flatter and quicker outside off, Moeen stays on the back foot in defense.
Flighted on middle, swept away straight to square leg.
Arm ball around off, skidding away, Moeen tries to sweep but misses. The keeper collects the ball, takes off the bails and appeals. Nothing from the square leg umpire.
Quicker and fuller on middle, dug out to mid-wicket.
Flighted and full outside off, Moeen lunges and gently pushes it through the gap at covers. Nicely placed for a couple of runs.
Short and wide outside leg, Stokes pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Moeen leans forward and opens the face of the bat to defend it on the off side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Appeal for an lbw as Moeen fails to defend a full ball off his pads. The impact is in line but it's spinning down too much and would have easily missed leg. Not given by the umpire.
Spinning down the leg side, big turn, Moeen initially looks to play but then shoulders arms. It goes off his thigh pad towards leg gully.
Full floated outside off, spinning in, Moeen closes the face of the bat and pushes it towards short mid-wicket.
Fuller and on off, knocked down to long on for a single.
Slow loopy ball on off, Moeen lunges and defends it off the inner half of the bat. Decent over and well played by Moeen!
Too full on this occasion, around leg, it's flicked across the line to mid-wicket.
Prods forward and defends a full ball solidly.
Flighted and down the leg side, Moeen leaves it alone.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Tossed up ball on middle, blocked off the back foot.
Quicker and fuller around leg, Stokes goes deep inside the crease and defends it to the leg side.
Flatter and shorter on off, defended off the back foot.
Lunges to a full ball and defends it with the spin to the on side.
Full flighted ball on middle, it's defended off the front foot to the leg side.
Ben Stokes arrives.

OUT! Sharp catch by Kayes! A flighted full ball on middle, Ballance goes down and plays a firm sweep shot. However, he fails to keep it down and Kayes at leg gully shows great reflexes to hold on to a sharp catch. That's brilliantly done. England lead by 91 runs!
Looks to defend off is front foot but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Taijul Islam has been brought into the attack.
Gentle delivery, a harmless one down the leg side, Moeen allows it through to the keeper.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full floated on off, it's defended off the front foot.
Goes down on one knee and sweeps it straight to square leg.
Advances down the track for a big heave over mid-wicket but fails to connect. The second line of defense comes in way to protect him, which is the pads.
Flighted on middle, defended with the spin to short mid-wicket.
Ballance has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Gets back and punches it through cover-point for a single.
Quicker through the air, around off and spinning away with big bounce, Ali tries to defend but misses.
Ballance has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Sharp spin away from the batsman, Ballance pushes at it and misses.
Gets forward and defends it off his front foot.
Short on middle, pulled in front of square leg for a single.
FOUR! Fuller in length and around middle, Ballance gets across the stumps and sweeps it past leg gully. It races through and beats the diving effort in the deep for a boundary.
The batsman has swept that one through the leg side. They pick up a single.
Spinning down, Ballance fails to control his shot and it pops out off the inside half of the bat. The ball balloons over short leg and wide of leg gully and they take a single.
Gets down on one knee and sweeps it through square leg for a single.

NOT OUT! It indeed has touched the helmet. Tossed up ball landing on middle and spinning down, Moeen goes back to work it on the leg side but fails to control the extra bounce. He ends up pushing it uppishly towards short leg where Mominul takes the catch. Moeen is going nowhere as he feels it has touched the helmet of short leg's fielder. The umpire goes upstairs and the replay confirm that it wobbled out of Mominul's hands, clipped the grille of his helmet and then settled under his grasp. That's against the rule. Moeen survives.
Appeal for a catch. Moeen is holding his ground as he feels it touched the helmet of short leg while the fielder caught the ball. Referred upstairs. Soft signal is not out.
Quicker one on off, Ballance defends it off the inner half of the bat to short leg.
Loopy full ball on middle, Ballance presses forward and blocks.
Flatter and around off, Ballance goes on the back foot in defense.
Very full this time, dipping into the batsman, Gary defends it back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, spinning away, Moeen hangs back and punches it past the diving short cover fielder for a single.
A touch short in length, Moeen goes back and whips it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
That's the plan! Flighted ball on leg, fuller in length, Ballance flicks it off the inside half of the bat and it goes on one bounce to the leg gully fielder.
Wrong line, spinning down the leg side, Ballance tries flicking but misses.
Spinning down the leg side, Moeen turns it across the line, a bit uppish but wide of short leg for a single at deep mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball on middle, defended off the pads to short leg.
Too full in length and around leg agaib, Ballance gets forward and works it in the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
Floated full ball on leg, it's defended off the front foot to the leg side.
Tossed up ball on off, turning away a bit, Moeen tries to defend but is beaten by the spin.
Physio comes out and Shafiul Islam is taken off the field. He is walking gingerly but seems fine.
Goes down on one knee and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket where Shafiul Islam makes a tumbling stop. They cross for a couple and it seems the fielder has hurt himself in the process.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Lunges to a full ball and keeps it out safely.
Spinning away from the batsman, Moeen taps it down with the turn to first slip.
Ballance has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Tossed up and outside off, easily defended off the front foot by Ali to end the over, a wicket maiden!
Too full on this occasion, around middle, Moeen gets behind the line and pushes it back.
Flighted and around off, Moeen defends it off his pads to the leg side.
Loopy full ball outside off, Moeen stretches forward and defends it.

Welcome back for the post-lunch session. Whichever side wins the upcoming couple of hours could take control of the Test match. Players and umpires are out there in the middle. Gary Ballance walks out with the new man Moeen Ali. Shakib to complete his over.
.....DAY 3, SESSION 2.....

The track is assisting spin and variable bounce is increasingly evident. Mehedi and Shakib were a touch short to start with but once they got their radar right, the results were there for all to see. Lead for England is 73 and we all know batting last on this minefield would be tough. Another fascination session is coming up shortly. Do join us in a while for it.

What a finish to the session! This Test match continues to thrill us. Having given away a more than handy lead of 45, Bangladesh started the second innings with spin from both ends and reaped the rewards. Mehedi removed the big fish Cook while Shakib removed Root and then Duckett just at the stroke of lunch to ensure that the session ended even for both sides.

OUT! Shakib has another! What a game this is turning out to be! Floated on middle, spinning in with extra bounce as Duckett looks to flick. Strikes the glove in the process and then balloons off the pads to Mominul at forward short leg. The appeal for a catch is given and Duckett decides not to review it. Bangladesh sign off the session with a bang. IT'S LUNCH ON DAY 3.
Floats it up around leg stump, turns down the leg side as Duckett misses the flick.
Last over before lunch.
Shorter and spinning away, Ballance goes back for the cut initially but then decides to let it pass.
Fired in around off with a round-arm action, Ballance gets forward and blocks it well.
Beauty! The off break hisses and fizzes off the deck. Spins sharply with bounce to beat the outside edge.
Flighted outside off, Duckett drives it through the covers for a single.
Flatter outside off, punched off the back foot to the covers.
Shorter and spinning away, Duckett steers it with the turn to point.
Flighted just outside off, Ballance gets forward and pushes it towards forward short leg.
Shorter in length on off, punched off the back foot to the leg side.
Drifting in from around off, spinning in, Ballance uses his feet and jams it to mid-wicket.
Fuller around off, Ballance reaches out to smother it to the ground.
GARY BALLANCE is the new man in.

OUT! GOT HIM! Floats it up on leg stump, straightens a bit to rap Root on the front pad as he misses the sweep. Looked plumb to the naked eye and the umpire raises his finger to oblige the lbw appeal. Root has a chat with Duckett and opts for the review. Nothing on the Hot Spot. Impact is in line and that's knocking middle stump out. Another massive wicket for Bangladesh, they've got both the big guns in successive overs. 150th Test scalp for Shakib. Perfect start for the hosts and it's game on. LEAD IS 72 now.
Root has been given out lbw. He goes for the review.
Flatter outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Slider on leg stump, Duckett's stuck in the crease and is pinned on the back pad. Needless lbw appeal, that was missing leg.
Flatter outside off, Duckett looks to sweep but is beaten by away spin.
Quicker ball on off, punched off the back foot to the covers.
Fuller on middle and leg, swept behind square leg for a single.
Floats up the off break on off, turns in sharply to rap him on the pads.
Joe Root walks in next.

OUT! Edged and gone! Huge wicket for Bangladesh and it's their debutant hero Mehedi who draws first blood. Floats up the off break around off, Cook's stuck on the crease and has a tame push at it. The outside edge flies low to first slip where Mahmudullah takes a very fine catch. Went two-handed towards it but the ball sticks to his right hand. Twin failure for the England captain.
Fuller on off, Cook lunges forward and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Drifting in from outside off, Duckett sweeps it through square leg. There's protection in the deep now and so just a single.
A bit shorter outside off, Duckett looks to cut but bottom edges it to point.

FOUR! Excellent shot! Tossed up outside off, Duckett goes down on one knee and nails the sweep well through square leg to find the fence. Very smart batting and this is always a key shot against the spinning ball.
Loopy around off, Duckett taps it with the turn to leg slip where it is well stopped.
Floater on middle, Duckett steps out but doesn't get to the pitch of the ball. Gets rapped on the pads.
A bit short outside off, Duckett goes back and punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Fullish outside off, Duckett reaches out and blocks it.
Flatter outside off, defended well from the crease.
Tossed up outside off, Duckett has a half-hearted push at it and the turn forces an outside edge. Well wide of slip though. Single taken.
Darted in on the pads, Cook clips it to the leg side for a single.
Fuller outside off, Cook leans forward and taps it to mid off.
Drifting in on middle, Duckett nudges it with the turn towards forward short leg.
Flighted around off, turning in, Duckett works it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Fuller on middle, spinning in, Cook gets across and just clips it towards short leg for a single.
Darted in on leg stump, Cook hangs back and nudges it to the leg side.
Fired around leg stump, Cook stays back and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Floated around leg stump, Cook gets across and tucks it to forward short leg.
Quicker ball outside off, Duckett gets back and blocks it well.
Fuller outside off, Cook leans forward and pushes it to the covers for a single.
Fuller outside off, Cook presses forward and smothers it to the ground.
Quicker ball outside off, defended well off the back foot.
Fuller outside off, bunted towards mid off for a single.
Risky from Duckett! Flighted of break on off, steps out to play the lofted shot against the spin. Gets a leading edge that just clears mid off. Brace added.
Sliding in on middle, Cook stays back and defends it well.
Fired in on middle, worked towards short fine leg for a single.
Quicker ball outside off, blocked well off the back foot.
Flatter outside off, defended well from the crease.
Flatter on middle and off, Duckett steps out to push at it but goes off the pads to short leg.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked to the leg side. That wasn't far away from the FSL fielder.

Loud appeal! The slider from Mehedi and Cook doesn't pick it. Gets pinned on the front pad and up go Bangladesh in appeal for lbw. Impact might have saved the England captain here. Rahim doesn't want to risk the review with just one left in the bank. Right decision from him too.
Floated outside off, Cook drives it to short cover where it is well stopped.
Drifting in around off, Cook pushes at it but gets it off the inside half to short leg.
Loopy on a length outside off, Cook nudges it with the turn to the off side.
Darted into the pads, Duckett works it behind square for a single.
Short and spinning away, cut away to sweeper cover for a single. Bangla bowlers yet to settle into a good line and length.
A touch short outside off, Duckett hangs back and punches it through the covers for a brace.
Fuller on middle, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.

Drifting in around leg stump, Duckett works it to short fine leg for a brisk single. Mehedi fires in a good throw at the keeper's end and Rahim whips off the bails in a flash. Appeal for the run out and it's checked upstairs but Cook is well in.
Appeal for a run out and it's being checked upstairs. Cook is the man in question. Seemed okay to the naked eye.
Shortish again outside off, spinning in as Duckett jabs it to mid off.
A bit short on middle, spinning in, Cook backs away and taps it to cover for a single.
Drifting in on a length on off, defended well off the back foot by Cook.
Shakib Al Hasan has been introduced into the attack from the other end. A slip, leg slip and forward short leg in place...
Flatter outside off, blocked well off the back foot.

NOT OUT! Floated just around off, skids through off the deck with extra bounce into the gloves of Rahim. Loud appeal, presumably for caught behind. The umpire is unmoved. Rahim decides to review it after a discussion with his mates. Seemingly, the appeal is for lbw. Replays show that it did brush the front pad! No bat involved and this now looks a good appeal. Hawk Eye however shows it's going over the stumps. An eventful review indeed and Duckett survives.
Bangladesh have taken a review for lbw against Duckett. Didn't seem to be a convincing review but who knows? Great ball nevertheless.
Floated outside off, Duckett lets it pass.
Short again outside off, lower bounce this time and Cook rocks back to bunt it towards extra cover. Single taken.
FOUR! Cut away! Short and outside off, spinning away, Cook sits back and cuts it away through point. Easy pickings for the English skipper. The tourists' second innings is off and running.
Ripper to start! The off break spins away sharply with bounce to beat Cook's outside edge.
